title: 靠墙把手臂抬一点
description: 成人靠普通墙站立，双臂由W形轻缓向上移动。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands with the back near a plain wall, feet a comfortable distance forward, and bent arms forming an easy W shape. Capture the arms sliding a small distance upward within a comfortable range, with ribs quiet and shoulders lowered. The palms need not be forced flat against the wall. A side angle reveals natural posture, while a muted plant and a gym tote occupy the far edge of the scene. Use soft chalk-pastel illustration with tactile color masses, gently smudged architecture, and lavender, muted orange, and deep blue accents. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
